description: Free, read-only pricing lookup for locked results from an existing search_matches search. Returns the currently available unlock packages and prices for the supplied search_id without creating checkout or charging the buyer. Use create_checkout only after a buyer chooses a package; use search_matches first if you do not yet have a search_id.

search_id.description: Reusable PaidHandshake search identifier returned by search_matches. Pass the exact search_id whose currently available result-unlock packages and prices you want to inspect.

name: get_unlock_quote
